name: Ca khoai Cai Doi Vam
summary: Cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm is the town’s dried cá khoai. VOV calls it cá khô khoai from a drying village. Nhân Dân lists cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm as a collective trademark. The airline hotpot is a different plate and does not name this town.
origin: Thị trấn Cái Đôi Vàm, huyện Phú Tân, as VOV printed it on 24 October 2020.
howToEat: VOV describes a drying craft, not a table recipe. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
Lẩu cá khoai, on the Vietnam Airlines page, is the hotpot of the same fish, with herbs and bún, and it names no ward.
where: Cái Đôi Vàm, Phú Tân, for the dried mark. No stall is named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca khoai Cai Doi Vam — dried fish from the coast
seoDescription: Cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm is the dried fish VOV ties to that coastal town. The airline hotpot does not name the town. A price is Check on arrival.
